//: The app's tsconfig.json for tsc alone. A shared hook (../src/lib/retry-key.ts) imports react, which tsc looks for above ../src/lib, in the website's node_modules, and CI's mobile job installs only this project. Metro (metro.config.js) and Jest (jest.resolver.js) already resolve such imports from here; this gives tsc the same answer. It is not in tsconfig.json because Metro and jest-expo turn its paths into module mappings, and the package's code is not its types. `paths` replaces the base's, so it repeats them.
